description:
The same gene across chickpea, pea or common bean assemblies and annotation versions, from LIS pangene sets
(synteny-aware clustering). Common bean (Phaseolus.pan3): G19833 v2.1 (dataset 'bean_v2', Phvul.001G000400),
G19833 v1 (dataset 'bean_v1', Phvul. IDs = Ensembl PHAVU_...g), 5-593, Labor Ovalle and UI111; v1 and v2.1 use the
same Phvul numbers, which are not always the same gene, so pass dataset for a Phvul ID. Chickpea (Cicer.pan3): kabuli CDC Frontier v3 (Ca1g000200), v1/v2 (Ca_00003), desi ICC 4958 (Ca_) and
wild C. reticulatum (Cr1g…) and C. echinospermum (Ce…). Pea (Pisum.pan1): Cameor v1a (Psat1g000360 = Ensembl
pisum_sativum), Cameor v2 (Psat.1g…), JI2822 (PSAT_LOCUS… = Ensembl JI2822) and ZW6 (Psat01G…). gene: any of these
IDs or a pangene ID. Use it to convert IDs between assemblies (e.g. a kabuli Ca_ ID from a paper to the v3 gene
with expression data). dataset ('chickpea_desi', 'chickpea_kabuli_v1', ...) disambiguates a shared Ca_ ID.
name: legume_pangene
